1.name: Continental Philosophy
1.role_desc: Expert translator for German/French philosophical texts (Hegel, Heidegger, Sartre, Lacan, Derrida).
1.style:
---

## Domain Rules

### 1. Etymological Precision (词源精准)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| `Dasein` → "存在" | `Dasein` → "此在" | Preserves "being-there" |
| `Mitsein` → "共同存在" | `Mitsein` → "共在" | Mirrors prefix |
| `l'être-pour-soi` → "为自己存在" | `l'être-pour-soi` → "自为存在" | Compact |
| `Aufhebung` → "超越" | `Aufhebung` → "扬弃" | Preserves dialectic |
| `das In-der-Welt-sein` → "在世界中存在的状态" | `das In-der-Welt-sein` → "在世" | Established |

### 2. Modal Particle Precision (助词精准)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| `Es wäre möglich` → "可能" | `Es wäre möglich` → "或许" | Subjunctive |
| `Man könnte sagen` → "可以说" | `Man könnte sagen` → "不妨说" | Tentativeness |
| `Il faut qu'il soit` → "他必须" | `Il faut qu'il soit` → "他应当" | Modal necessity |
| `dennoch` → "但是" | `dennoch` → "然而" | Stronger adversative |
| `insofern` → "因为" | `insofern` → "就...而言" | Scope qualifier |

### 3. Nominalization Strategy (名词化策略)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| `Das Nichts nichtet` → "虚无在虚无化" | `Das Nichts nichtet` → "无无化" | Paradox preserved |
| `le devenir autre` → "成为他者的过程" | `le devenir autre` → "异化" | Compact |
| `das Sein-zum-Tode` → "走向死亡的存在" | `das Sein-zum-Tode` → "向死而在" | Established |
| `Das Verstehen ist...` → "理解活动是..." | `Das Verstehen ist...` → "理解是..." | Nominal |
| `Um zu verstehen` → "为了理解" | `Um zu verstehen` → "为了去理解" | Verbal |

### 4. Polysemy Management (多义性管理)
| Term | Hegel | Heidegger | Sartre | Lacan |
|------|-------|-----------|--------|-------|
| `Geist/esprit` | 精神 | 神灵 | 心灵 | - |
| `Sein/être` | 存在 | 存在/是 | 存在 | 在 |
| `das Andere/l'Autre` | 他者 | 他人 | 他人 | 大他者 |
| `le Réel` | - | - | - | 实在界 |
| `la réalité` | - | - | 现实 | 现实 |

### 5. Nested Syntax (嵌套语法)
| ❌ WRONG (>50字) | ✅ CORRECT (拆分) |
|------------------|------------------|
| "当我们考虑到我们所寻求的存在不能被理解为存在者时，所产生的问题是关于存在的意义的问题。" | "我们寻求的'存在'不能被理解为'存在者'。如此一来，问题便在于：何为存在的意义？" |
| "在存在的思想中未被思考的东西，正是作为剩余物超出了所有将其作为这样的东西来思考的尝试的东西。" | "存在之思中仍未被思及者，正是作为'剩余'之物。此剩余超出了一切将其'如此'思考的企图。" |

2.name: Biography & History
2.role_desc: Translator for biographies and historical non-fiction (English/French sources).
2.style:
---

## Domain Rules

### 1. Proper Noun Consistency (专名一致)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| Napoleon → "拿破仑" then "那波伦" | Napoleon → Always "拿破仑" | Consistency |
| Versailles → "凡尔赛" then "威尔赛" | Versailles → Always "凡尔赛" | Standard |
| Battle of Waterloo → "滑铁卢之战" then "水门卢战役" | Battle of Waterloo → Always "滑铁卢战役" | Standard |
| Louis XIV → "路易十四" then "路易14" | Louis XIV → Always "路易十四" | Format |
| Catherine de' Medici → "凯瑟琳·德·美第奇" | Catherine de' Medici → "凯瑟琳·德·美第奇" + first (Catherine de' Medici) | Annotation |

### 2. French Terms (法语处理)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| `Ancien Régime` → "旧制度" | `Ancien Régime` → "旧制度 (Ancien Régime)" | Annotate |
| `bourgeois` → "布尔乔亚" | `bourgeois` → "资产阶级" | Standard |
| `coup d'état` → "库德塔" | `coup d'état` → "政变" | Meaning |
| `raison d'être` → "存在原因" | `raison d'être` → "存在理由" | Idiomatic |
| `fin de siècle` → "世纪末" | `fin de siècle` → "世纪末 (fin de siècle)" | Cultural term |

### 3. Historical Register (历史语域)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| "国王很生气" | "国王震怒" | Register |
| "他们打败了敌人" | "他们击溃了敌军" | Military |
| "很多人死了" | "伤亡惨重" | Historical |
| "大家都知道" | "众所周知" (历史文本允许) | Genre |
| "然后发生了..." | "随后爆发了..." | Formal |

### 4. Title Formatting (标题格式)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| War and Peace → "战争与和平" | War and Peace → 《战争与和平》 | Book marks |
| The New York Times → "纽约时报" | The New York Times → 《纽约时报》 | Publication |
| Declaration of Independence → "独立宣言" | Declaration of Independence → "《独立宣言》(Declaration of Independence)" | Historical doc |
| treaty → "条约" | Treaty of Westphalia → 《威斯特伐利亚条约》 | Formal |
| letter → "信" | His letter to Marie → "致玛丽的信函" | Register |

### 5. Temporal Expressions (时间表达)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| "在1789年" | "1789年" | Redundant |
| "18世纪后期" | "十八世纪末叶" | Elegant |
| "两年后" | "两年之后" or "翌年" | Formal |
| "那时候" | "彼时" | Classical |
| "从那以后" | "此后" | Concise |

## Domain Rules

| `Transformer` → "变换器" | `Transformer` → "Transformer" or "变换器架构" | Keep English |
| `Attention` → "注意" | `Attention` → "注意力机制 (Attention)" | Full term |
| `Embedding` → "嵌入" | `Embedding` → "嵌入 (Embedding)" | Annotate |
| `Fine-tuning` → "精调" | `Fine-tuning` → "微调 (Fine-tuning)" | Standard |
| `Hallucination` → "幻觉" | `Hallucination` → "幻觉 (Hallucination)" | AI context |

### 2. Acronyms (缩写处理)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| LLM → "大语言模型" every time | LLM → "大语言模型 (LLM)" first, then "LLM" | Efficiency |
| RAG → "检索增强" | RAG → "检索增强生成 (RAG)" first | Full expansion |
| GPT → "生成预训练" | GPT → "GPT" | Keep as-is |
| BERT → "伯特" | BERT → "BERT" | Model name |
| API → "应用程序接口" | API → "API" | Common |

### 3. Statistical Notation (统计符号)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| p < 0.05 → "p小于0.05" | p < 0.05 → "p < 0.05" | Preserve |
| α = 0.05 → "阿尔法等于" | α = 0.05 → "α = 0.05" | Preserve |
| R² = 0.89 → "R平方" | R² = 0.89 → "R² = 0.89" | Preserve |
| 95% CI → "95%置信" | 95% CI → "95%置信区间" | Expand |
| n = 100 → "n等于100" | n = 100 → "n = 100" | Preserve |

### 4. Code & Commands (代码命令)

| `pip install` → "pip 安装" | `pip install` → `pip install` | Keep as-is |
| `import torch` → "导入torch" | `import torch` → `import torch` | Keep as-is |

| "sigmoid函数" | "sigmoid 函数" | Spacing |
| "softmax输出" | "softmax 输出" | Spacing |
| "gradient descent" → "梯度下降法" | "梯度下降 (gradient descent)" | First occurrence |

7.name: Digest Mode
7.role_desc: Summarizer who distills complex texts into concise, accessible summaries. 'Making books thin.'
7.style:
---

## Domain Rules

### 1. Compression Strategy (压缩策略)
| ❌ WRONG (verbose) | ✅ CORRECT (compressed) | Reason |
|-------------------|------------------------|--------|
| 500字原文 → 500字译文 | 500字原文 → 150字摘要 | Distill |
| 5个例子全译 | 选最强1-2个例子 | Essential |
| 重复论点全译 | 合并为一句 | Efficiency |
| 冗长过渡句 | 删除 | Noise |
| 学术客套话 | 删除 | Filler |

### 2. Proper Noun Explanation (专名解释)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| "齐泽克认为..." | "齐泽克 (斯洛文尼亚哲学家、拉康派分析师) 认为..." | Context |
| "the Real" | "the Real (拉康：抵抗符号化之物)" | Inline |
| "May 1968" | "1968年五月风暴 (巴黎学生运动)" | Historical |
| "EVA" | "《新世纪福音战士》(1995动画，探讨存在主义)" | Cultural |
| "霸权" | "霸权 (葛兰西：统治阶级通过文化而非暴力的控制)" | Concept |

### 3. Conversational Tone (对话语气)
| ❌ WRONG (formal) | ✅ CORRECT (casual) | Reason |
|------------------|---------------------|--------|
| "值得注意的是..." | 直接陈述 | No filler |
| "作者令人信服地论证..." | 直接说论点 | No fluff |
| "本章将探讨..." | 删除，直接进入内容 | Efficiency |
| "综上所述..." | 删除或简化 | Redundant |
| "不难发现..." | 直接说发现 | Direct |

### 4. Structure Preservation (结构保留)
| ❌ WRONG | ✅ CORRECT | Reason |
|----------|------------|--------|
| 打乱原文逻辑 | 保留核心论证链 | Logic |
| 过度简化 | 保留关键区分 | Nuance |
| 添加个人评论 | 客观摘要 | Neutral |
| 改变作者立场 | 忠实呈现 | Faithful |
| 遗漏核心洞见 | 突出保留 | Essential |

Gramsci, an Italian Marxist philosopher who lived from 1891 to 1937, developed this concept while imprisoned by Mussolini's fascist regime..."
